text:
Priya: FYI rolling out IdP metadata change for partner globex (switch NameIDFormat to transient) and immediately started getting reports: users could not SSO and a flurry of SCIM deprovisions/creates. Saw odd failures in provisioner logs.

Liam: paste errors?

Priya: two examples: SAML verify fail and SCIM PATCH that created new account because lookup by NameID failed:
```
[saml] ERROR verify_response: Assertion validation failed: Subject NameID mismatch (expected persistent, got transient)
[sso] /saml/acs?relay=... 401 AssertionInvalid
---
PATCH /scim/v2/Users/fe4b2a
Content-Type: application/json
{ "externalId": "user-globex-123", "active": false }
HTTP/1.1 201 Created
{ "id": "u-9f7c" }  <-- new resource created, old user still present
```
This looks like the provisioner couldn't map incoming SAML NameID to existing SCIM externalId so it created a new user.

Nora: also seeing KMS sign errors around the same time in the SAML proxy logs: `kms.Sign failed: AccessDeniedException` for key `arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111111:key/abcd-ef01`. That key was rotated Tuesday during the RBAC rename rollout.

OpsBot: [alert] surge: 43 SCIM create events for tenant globex between 2026-04-05T02:12:00Z and 02:18:00Z. Incident 1765554321 opened.

Liam: timeline check: RBAC rename rollout touched service account roles at 02:05, KMS key rotate 02:08, IdP metadata flip 02:10. So ordering could make provisioners/processes out of sync with new key policy.

Priya: risk: if SAML assertions are unsigned or signatures failing, our proxy drops subject mapping and the downstream SCIM sync treats it as a different identity. That explains duplicates.

Nora: confirmed KMS policy change removed `arn:aws:iam::111111:role/saml-proxy` entry by mistake in the rework. Deployed policy now requires `saml-proxy-v2` role. Running instances still using `saml-proxy` can't sign/verify, others can. Mixed behavior = partial failures.

Liam: mitigation options: (a) rollback IdP metadata change to persistent NameIDFormat, (b) add old role back to KMS key policy until all instances upgrade, (c) pause SCIM autosync for globex and run reconcile.

Priya: doing (a) and (c) now. Paused autosync at 02:22Z and rolled IdP metadata back at 02:24Z.

OpsBot: [system] autosync paused for tenant globex by Priya at 2026-04-05T02:22:31Z.

Nora: I added the old role back to KMS key policy and incremented KMS audit sampling for that key to 100% for 1h. Pushed a quick fix PR to re-add the principal; waiting for codeowner approval.

Liam: good. Next: reconcile duplicates. Proposed heuristic: group by primary email, oauth subject, and compare created_at window. For duplicates where extid decrypt fails with new alias, attempt decrypt with previous aliases and merge. If ambiguous, flag for manual review.

Priya: sample reconcile steps I ran in staging (dry-run):
```bash
# list users in tenant
scim list --tenant globex --json > /tmp/globex-list.json
# group by email
python ops/reconcile_scim_dupes.py --input /tmp/globex-list.json --dry-run
```
Dry-run found 38 probable duplicates, 6 ambiguous.

Nora: security triage: any sign of malicious activity? No indicators so far. Creating SSO-2387 to track vulnerability review. We should treat this as high-impact availability/consistency issue and medium security risk because it exposes potential for orphaned service accounts.

Liam: action items: 1) keep old KMS principal in policy until full fleet updated (Nora), 2) run reconcile dry-run and then merge with scripted idempotent merges (Priya/Dave), 3) add rollout checklist step: freeze IdP metadata changes until KMS/role bindings confirmed (Liam).

Priya: I notified CS and AM for globex (ticket SSO-C-892). Also left note in runbook to run full audit export for the tenant for 24h window.

OpsBot: [automated] created ticket SSO-2387 (vuln-triage) and SSO-C-892 (customer notification).

Nora: follow-up: we'll schedule a postmortem to capture why role binding change and metadata flip happened so close. Also propose adding a pre-rotate checklist: verify instance role names and push orchestrator restart before KMS policy swap.

Liam: agreed. Also add a monitoring rule: if SCIM creates > 10/min for a tenant and SAML errors increase, auto-pause autosync and page oncall.

sec-oncall: oncall acknowledged. I'll join the PM stand-up to brief. Leaving an ops note: keep both principals for at least 2 deploy cycles after rotation, and ensure IdP metadata switches are gated behind a KMS readiness check. :white_check_mark:
